findings.claim: CROSS-LEG MERGE SEAMS (add/add). scope_weights.py, tests/test_scope_weights.py, and harness/jev/jev_grade.py are shared with bp10/corpus. My base (357bf1e7 scaffold) predates corpus's additions, so I reproduced corpus's RELEASED versions verbatim + my additions (guide activation; harvest guard). At merge these are add/add (scope_weights, test) or region-additive (jev_grade); resolution = take BP10-GUIDES' version, a superset of corpus's. Assumes dep order corpus->guides.

Activating the guide scope flips two now-stale inertness assertions in corpus-authored test_scope_weights.py (is_active('guide') False->True; table active False->True; ranked_scopes default gains 'guide'). This is the spec-mandated handoff corpus deferred with its own 'armed by BP10-GUIDES' comment, but it edits a peer's test text -- surfaced for INTEGRATOR/merge awareness.

tool_map.json carries 11 _unsure tool mappings (connect_nodes_batch, get_top_scheduler_info, get_geometry_info, get_usd_composition, get_usd_layers, get_usd_materials, get_usd_bound_material, get_expression, create_render_node, update_hda, set_hda_section_content). Jev ran JUDGED, not fallback: TYPESAFE_API_KEY resolved via jev_client's winreg path, so the harvest guard made 39 real System One calls (6 residual tokens + 33 tool refs), each ledgered with real request_id/probabilities to bp10.harvest.jsonl. The fail-closed path (no key -> deterministic grouping, header 'unjudged', one fallback row, no fabricated probability) is implemented and unit-covered but not exercised this run.

CONFIDENT-WRONG-DENOM: the live adversarial suite is 24 assertions over PREFLIGHT(5)+REGRESSION_TOPICS(4), which is BP10-CORPUS's 'G3 24/24' denominator, not a literal 25. The predicate's load-bearing measure (confident-wrong count) is 0; no 25th probe was invented and no number was entered without a producer path.
